gates.name: Architecture
gates.rationale: Exactly seven protected cores are preserved; Market & Value remains an outer system; Research/Evidence/Feedback remains the epistemic substrate.

gates.name: Coverage
gates.rationale: 254 primary nodes cover all 56 modules; all seven cores contain accepted knowledge; provisional-only modules are bounded rather than hidden.

gates.name: Evidence
gates.rationale: Material claims are atomic and provenance-bearing; 31 uncertainty records preserve non-certainty. Scientific saturation is explicitly not claimed.

gates.name: Causal Discipline
gates.rationale: Scientific edges preserve causal status; S4 assigned zero runtime effect weights; S7 separates observational, randomized bundle, and mechanism-level interpretations.

gates.name: Connection Validity
gates.rationale: All 21 unordered core pairs were audited; 35 scientific edges are bounded by evidence; 2 explicit non-edge decisions are preserved.

gates.name: Contradiction Integrity
gates.rationale: 7 contradiction/null/mixed-evidence records are retained; conflicting evidence is bounded through provisional status, moderators, and uncertainty instead of deleted.

gates.name: Measurement Validity
gates.rationale: S7 passed with 15 observable metrics and zero metric-integrity errors; platform metrics remain outcomes/proxies rather than silent latent-state measurements.

gates.name: Reasoning
gates.rationale: S6 passed 8/8 representative reasoning cases with 0 integrity errors.

gates.name: Copy Quality
gates.rationale: Frozen holdout passed 12/12 with mean dimension score 4.605 and zero critical failures. Evaluator independence limitation is disclosed separately.

gates.name: Generalization
gates.rationale: Regression 8/8, adversarial 8/8, and holdout 12/12 all passed with zero critical gate failures.

gates.name: Feedback Learning
gates.rationale: Feedback/update discipline passed 8/8; scientific updates remain candidate-only until research promotion.

gates.name: Skill Quality
gates.rationale: Repository Skill runtime passed static audit, 6/6 behavior cases, and trigger-design audit. Production host-router/installation is a deployment limitation, not a repository-runtime failure.

non_blocking_limitations.statement: The build agent also generated and scored the outputs. This is a real frozen holdout run against unchanged artifacts, but it is not an independent human or external-model evaluation.
non_blocking_limitations.impact: Independent human/external-model evaluation would strengthen release evidence; current frozen internal holdout remains valid but not independent.

non_blocking_limitations.statement: Automatic implicit selection by a production host/router was not executed in this repository workflow.
non_blocking_limitations.impact: Do not claim production auto-routing validation.

non_blocking_limitations.statement: No installation into a specific ChatGPT account/workspace is claimed.
non_blocking_limitations.impact: Repository package is complete and reusable; account/workspace deployment remains separate.
v1.0.0 is project-complete for defined release scope, not universally complete psychology/copywriting science.
